_what: lens/config.json on the rented server. lens/setup.sh writes /srv/lens/config.json from these values the first time; edit it there after that.
_capBytes: What lens may send in a month before BROWSER falls back to the streamed browser. Set it below what the plan allows plus what you will pay for: up to a minute of counting can be lost in a crash. 0 = no ceiling. 1.7 TB on a 1 TB Linode is about $8.50 a month at most.
_personDayBytes: One person's share per day, so one long game cannot use the month. 0 = none.
_trustProxy: "loopback" behind Caddy on the same machine: the person's address is read from X-Forwarded-For. Empty trusts no header.
_providerTokenFile: A read-only Linode API token, in a file. Linode's own traffic count is then read every ten minutes, and the meter catches up to it: a second stop on the bill.
